declarations.assertion: The shared blocker-legality boundary consumes current fear and preserves every other represented evasion restriction.
The shared blocker-legality boundary consumes current horsemanship and preserves every other represented evasion restriction.
The shared blocker-legality boundary consumes current intimidate and preserves every other represented evasion restriction.
The shared blocker-legality boundary consumes current shadow and preserves every other represented evasion restriction.
The shared blocker-legality boundary consumes current skulk and preserves every other represented evasion restriction.
Fear, Horsemanship, Intimidate, Shadow, and Skulk apply cumulatively from one immutable current-characteristics snapshot.
A typed Bushido occurrence resolves through the canonical identity-locked layer 7c until-end-of-turn effect owner.
A typed Flanking occurrence retains its source snapshot and modifies the exact blocker through the canonical layer 7c effect owner.
Flanking and Bushido occurrences from one complete multiplayer block transition share one sealed APNAP trigger batch.
A mana ability's tap cost consumes the current Haste exception to summoning sickness.
A creature's typed color-set mana ability consumes the shared current Haste exception before its tap cost can be paid.
The source-spanned color-set mana compiler descriptor drives the same current modes for projected offers and accepted runtime activation.
Equip attachment changes drive the attached permanent's live continuous characteristics.
The shared attack-declaration boundary consumes the current represented Defender ability.
Current Haste does not override Defender's independent attack prohibition.
Attack eligibility consumes the current represented Haste ability.
The declare-attackers tap owner consumes the current represented Vigilance ability.
Flying's block restriction and Reach's exception share the same offer and command legality boundary.
Ordinary Trample assignment is recomputed from the current blocker set in Double Strike's second damage step.
Indestructible does not change the lethal-damage amount ordinary Trample must assign before spill.
Ordinary Trample consumes the canonical assignment, replacement-order, event-identity, and replay boundary.
The First Strike keyword consumes the typed strike-step participant owner.
The Double Strike keyword consumes the typed strike-step owner in both real damage steps.
A Trample batch through Protection credits Lifelink only for final damage actually dealt.
Deathtouch changes ordinary Trample's lethal-assignment threshold while marked damage remains part of that threshold.
Indestructible prevents the tested Deathtouch destruction while the since-last-SBA marker is consumed exactly once.
Prevention aftermath counter placement reuses the canonical counter replacement pipeline.
Counter quantity replacements participate in the affected player's CR 122 counter event.
A typed Sunburst entry-counter event passes through the canonical quantity-replacement pipeline before its counters are committed.
Only positive damage, not life loss or fully prevented damage, satisfies the tested attack permission.
Infect replaces the ordinary CR 120 player or creature result with the correct counter result.
Wither routes damage through canonical minus-counter placement without suppressing the independent Deathtouch damage result.
The Lifelink damage result enters the canonical replaceable life-gain path.
A multitype permanent receives each applicable CR 120 damage result in one transaction.
The represented Toxic keyword produces its typed player-counter result after combat damage.
Wither changes the creature result to counters without erasing the deathtouch damage fact.
Printed Flash lowering drives both the advertised and accepted cast-timing permission.
A normalized zone-change occurrence supplies last-known controller data to trigger discovery.
Damage and state-based deaths feed their triggers into one APNAP placement batch.
The typed draw owner preserves individually replaceable CR 121 events across suspension and resume.
A targeted activated draw revalidates its selected player before the canonical draw transaction commits private identity and replay state.
A targeted fixed player-counter instruction revalidates the selected active player before the canonical counter transaction commits and replays the result.
Gonti's capability-closed player-counter result enters the canonical counter transaction and an actual player-applicable quantity replacement doubles the committed energy.
One source-spanned fixed artifact-entry trigger resolves its typed player-counter body without a reviewed-overlay operation or direct energy mutation.
A committed artifact-entry occurrence matches the source-controller predicate before Gonti's typed player-counter body resolves.
One generic program composes token creation, counter placement, and a temporary continuous effect.
Zone-change identity prevents a delayed trigger from following a reentered card object.
Multiplayer attack declarations determine the sequential defending-player block decisions.
Vigilance changes the declare-attackers turn-based tap result without changing priority sequencing.
The typed Menace restriction contributes one shared minimum to block offer, generic solver validation, and exact replay.
The typed restriction follows current represented gain and loss of Menace without a second runtime rules owner.
The declaration solver does not compel an illegal single block merely to satisfy an independent block requirement.
A typed layer-4 effect that adds Swamp to every land changes the current public land subtype consumed by the typed Basic Landwalk restriction.
The canonical layer-4 type evaluator adds and removes an opponent land's basic subtype while the CR 305.6 owner derives only the corresponding current intrinsic mana ability.
Murmuring Bosk's exact CR 305.6 Forest ability remains independently executable and replayable while its unsupported self-entry replacement retains both applicability and ordering residuals.
A Reach blocker that satisfies Flying remains prohibited when the same attacker has matching Basic Landwalk.
A Shadow blocker that satisfies Shadow remains prohibited when the same attacker has matching Basic Landwalk.
An entry replacement changes the zone event directly and does not create a triggered ability.
First Strike's initial participant snapshot and current Double Strike jointly determine second-step participation.
Reach is tested as the explicit exception to Flying's block restriction.
Protection prevention reduces the final amount used by Lifelink.
A typed Exalted occurrence from a noncreature source resolves on the exact lone attacker through the canonical layer 7c effect owner.
Battle Cry retains source last-known identity while Battle Cry and Melee resolve their sealed affected objects and amount through the canonical layer 7c owner.
Exalted, Battle Cry, and Melee derive from one immutable completed multiplayer attack declaration and enter one ordinary trigger batch before priority.
Ordinary Crew validates one source-excluding set against current effective signed power, commits its tap cost, and resolves through the canonical layer-4 until-end-of-turn owner.
The Crew layer-4 result adds Artifact and Creature while retaining an existing Legendary supertype, Land type, Island and Vehicle subtypes, and intrinsic Island mana ability under CR 205.1b.
One source-pinned Cycling activation pays the physical discard through normalized zone-change ownership before its ordinary stack object resolves through the canonical private draw transaction.
One source-pinned Typecycling activation suspends and resumes its replacement-aware discard cost before the same stack object opens its actor-private fixed type search.

Wizardcycling selects a real Wizard commander from the hidden library, suspends the search completion before mutation, privately applies the owner-chosen Commander hand replacement, then resumes the exact search transaction and replay with the card in the command zone.
The source-pinned direct tap clause advertises and revalidates the same public battlefield target before the canonical tap-state owner commits the transition.
A source-pinned direct untap clause revalidates its target and then composes with the represented stun-counter replacement without bypassing the canonical untap owner.
The compiled direct-target exile revalidates one public permanent, commits the owner-indexed public exile zone change, and preserves exact replay and seat projection.
The typed permanent-exile request enters the canonical zone-change replacement tree and reports the committed replacement destination without bypassing CR 400 ownership.

A characteristic-qualified public permanent target is selected and revalidated before the typed exile request enters the canonical destination-replacement tree and reports the committed graveyard result.
The compiled direct-target return revalidates one public permanent, commits the owner-hand zone change, and preserves the existing seat-scoped hidden-zone projection and exact replay boundary.
The typed return request enters the canonical zone-change replacement tree and reports the committed replacement destination without bypassing CR 400 ownership.
A typed direct counter revalidates the selected public stack identity immediately before execution and fails closed when that object already left the stack.
The direct counter owner consumes the exact trusted intrinsic counter-prohibition declaration pinned at cast commit and leaves the protected spell on the stack.
The direct all-counter removal family revalidates its one public permanent target before committing every present counter kind through one canonical batch.
The fixed named-counter removal family revalidates its one public permanent target before committing partial removal through the canonical typed owner.

A named-counter-qualified direct target is advertised and accepted only from the shared current public-state predicate before the fixed counter result enters the canonical transaction and replays exactly.
Current-turn entry history composes with effective color and subtype characteristics in one direct-target verdict without caching either fact from compilation.
The same current-turn entry predicate governs offer, submitted-command validation, and CR 608.2b revalidation, making the target illegal after the turn boundary changes.
An affected-set counter producer snapshots current-turn entrants at resolution, including a qualifying permanent added after lowering, then commits the APNAP-canonical batch once.
A current-turn-entry affected set is fixed before its counter batch suspends for competing quantity replacements, with no counter mutation before the ordering choice.
A bounded target-set counter producer excludes untapped creatures, rejects a selected creature that becomes untapped, and places the counter when the same target remains tapped.
The tapped-creature public-state predicate admits a still-tapped target before the fixed target-set producer places its represented stun counter through the keyword-counter boundary.
The bounded fixed target-set producer revalidates every selected public permanent and commits counters only to the still-legal subset.

An optional fixed target-set effect may choose no target while its positive loyalty-symbol cost still enters the replacement-aware cost transaction, creates the stack object, resolves without target mutation, and replays exactly.
A card that combines an exact optional fixed counter-target ability with unresolved damage-prevention prose remains unavailable at strict CardProgram runtime admission.
The fixed same-kind subject group revalidates each printed direct-target instance independently and commits only the source or targets that still resolve.
One immutable printed-order subject group enters the canonical counter transaction, suspends for affected-seat quantity-replacement ordering, and resumes with exact replay.
The attachment-relative counter producer consumes one immutable current-or-last-known source relation without learning authoritative identity from Oracle text.
The resolved attached-object reference enters the canonical quantity-replacement transaction, suspends for affected-seat ordering, and resumes with exact replay.
Support delegates its surviving target set to the canonical counter owner, suspends for the affected permanent's quantity-replacement order, and resumes exactly once.
Support revalidates every originally selected creature and applies +1/+1 counters only to the still-legal subset.
A resolved ordinary Mentor trigger delegates its +1/+1 result to the canonical counter transaction, which applies the represented quantity replacement before commit.
Mentor revalidates current source and target power through the shared resolution target boundary before the counter producer can commit.
A battlefield departure refreshes Mentor's pending relative-power condition from the source's immediate predeparture characteristics before CR 400 creates a new logical object.
A qualified Dethrone occurrence preserves its declaration-time life comparison and delegates the resolving +1/+1 result to canonical counter quantity replacement.
Dethrone affects the original physical and logical source after a control change but not a returned new incarnation or phased-out object.
Dethrone occurrences join the ordinary declaration-time trigger batch and same-controller ordering continuation before priority.
A qualified Training occurrence preserves its declaration-time power comparison and delegates the resolving +1/+1 result to canonical counter quantity replacement.
Training qualification compares the canonical effective power snapshot for every creature declared as an attacker.
Training occurrences join the ordinary declaration-time trigger batch and same-controller ordering continuation before priority.

One fixed Modular instance composes the prospective self-entry replacement, normalized battlefield-to-graveyard trigger, frozen counter LKI, and canonical target counter transaction without a card-specific mutation path.
The frozen Modular controller retains the optional choice while the artifact-creature target predicate is reevaluated at resolution and rejects a target that lost creature type.
A noncreature permanent with Modular uses the generic battlefield-to-graveyard permanent event and retains its counter LKI without borrowing creature-dies semantics.
A four-player Modular trigger uses ordinary controller-scoped trigger placement and exposes its public choice only to the frozen controller while preserving exact replay.
Renown discovers its trigger from the final normalized combat-damage result, including damage redirected to the source's controller, rather than from the originally proposed recipient.
Renown resolves through canonical counter quantity replacement and then applies its independent renowned designation even when replacement reduces the counter result to zero.
Renown's intervening condition follows the original logical object and current public designation, so an old trigger cannot affect a returned incarnation or an object already made renowned.
One immutable APNAP-canonical target set suspends for permanent-counter quantity replacement and resumes the same batch with exact replay.
One exact printed Unleash instance lowers its optional entry-counter half to a distinct capability-closed typed program.
One exact printed Unleash instance lowers its counter-conditional block half to a distinct capability-closed typed program.
An accepted optional self-entry counter becomes a nested canonical counter event and consumes the represented quantity replacement before entry commits.
The public counter state committed by the optional entry producer is consumed by the shared blocker-legality prohibition without a second Oracle interpreter.
Each exact printed Riot instance lowers to one independent capability-closed typed linked entry-choice program.
The counter result of Riot becomes a nested canonical counter event and consumes represented quantity replacement before entry commits.
The alternative Riot result grants typed layer-6 Haste that the existing attack legality owner consumes for the current zone object.
The alternative Riot result grants typed layer-6 Haste that the existing tap and untap cost legality owner consumes for the current zone object.

One prospective token batch resumes an additional-token choice and then an intrinsic-entry counter-quantity choice without duplicating either replacement or exposing either continuation to another seat.
One compiled fixed Treasure instruction suspends for two competing additional-token replacements and commits the Treasure, Thopter, and Map definitions through one canonical creation transaction.

Knight-Captain of Eos pays the compiler-owned Soldier sacrifice, resolves its typed all-combat prevention shield, prevents real combat damage, replays exactly, and preserves the independently trusted Soldier token trigger.
Gideon, Ally of Zendikar exposes fixed token grammar beside unresolved self-prevention prose, but the unresolved CardProgram remains incompatible with runtime admission.
Topography Tracker executes its trusted fixed Map trigger while the separate Explore replacement applicability span remains residual and contributes no runtime handler.
Topography Tracker executes its trusted fixed Map trigger while the separate self-replacement and prevention-ordering span remains residual and contributes no runtime handler.
Persist returns the same graveyard incarnation under its owner and delegates its -1/-1 entry counter to the canonical effect-qualified quantity-replacement path.
Persist suspends competing destination and counter replacements before either the return or its -1/-1 counter can mutate authoritative state.
Persist resumes the affected-seat counter replacement continuation without exposing its authoritative batch and replays to the identical final hash.
A persisted pending Persist quantity-replacement continuation reloads for the same seat and physical graveyard incarnation, commits once, and remains exactly replayable.
Undying suspends competing destination and counter replacements before either the return or its +1/+1 counter can mutate authoritative state.
Undying resumes the affected-seat counter replacement continuation without exposing its authoritative batch and replays to the identical final hash.
A persisted pending Undying quantity-replacement continuation reloads for the same seat and physical graveyard incarnation, commits once, and remains exactly replayable.
The effect-qualified quantity replacement applies to a Saga's nested entry lore counter but not to its later rule-generated precombat lore action.

Read Ahead creates its chosen lore-counter child inside the canonical quantity-replacement tree; a doubled result then suppresses every entry chapter under the exact-count gate and exposes the completed Saga to its final-chapter state action.
Competing Saga entry quantity replacements suspend before zone or counter mutation and produce the two legal order-dependent lore totals.
Simultaneous Saga entry quantity choices are requested from affected controllers in four-player APNAP order without preparation mutation.
The Saga entry quantity decision remains visible only to its affected controller and replays the selected lore result to the identical hash.
A persisted pending Saga entry quantity continuation reloads for the same affected seat, commits one lore result, and remains exactly replayable.

One source-spanned target sequence commits its fixed counter through the canonical counter owner, then commits a separate typed layer-6 grant that survives cleanup and source departure but stops applying after the target changes logical identity.

A persisted affected-seat counter-replacement continuation reloads without exposing another seat, commits the fixed counter, executes the persistent keyword result once, and replays to the identical final hash.
A target that leaves and returns during a synthetic suspended counter replacement no longer matches the pinned logical identity, so the whole sequence fails before partial mutation.
One printed Exhaust mana ability consumes only its own typed use, commits the selected fixed output explicitly, cannot be reversed through the ordinary tap-mana UI boundary, and replays exactly.

A four-player Exhaust activation commits one per-ability use, suspends its source-counter instruction for affected-object quantity-replacement ordering, resumes the same physical and logical source into one duration-pinned keyword result, preserves seat privacy, and replays exactly.

A source that leaves and returns while its counter result is suspended no longer matches the pinned logical identity, so replacement resume rejects before committing either the counter or the later characteristic result.

Fixed Adapt checks the current source only at resolution, suspends its +1/+1 counter request for affected-object replacement ordering, commits through the canonical counter owner, and replays the chosen quantity exactly.

Fixed Amass exhausts additional-token replacements before discovering the resulting Army set, then exhausts counter-quantity replacements before completing, with both suspended choices replaying to the same authoritative state.
Fixed Amass commits the counter result before one layer-4 subtype addition, and the subtype effect expires when the affected Army becomes a new zone object.

Fixed Monstrosity resumes one four-player counter-replacement continuation, commits the counter result before the public monstrous designation, preserves the affected-seat projection, and replays the designation and value exactly.
The monstrous designation is bound to one battlefield incarnation, is not copied to another object, and is cleared when a zone transition creates a new logical object.

A four-player affected-seat quantity-replacement choice completes before a Flying counter changes effective layer-6 characteristics, remains hidden from other seats while pending, and replays to the same state hash.

A canonically placed Flying counter changes the exact effective-keyword snapshot consumed by both advertised and accepted block declarations, rejects a ground block without mutation, and replays the no-block declaration exactly.
A canonically placed Vigilance counter enters the current effective-keyword view used by the four-player attack tap owner, leaves the legal attacker untapped, and replays the declaration exactly.

A canonically placed Double strike counter creates the first combat-damage step and remains in the current effective-keyword snapshot that permits the source to participate in the second step, with exact replay.
A canonically placed Lifelink counter is captured in the combat source snapshot and produces one canonical life-gain result from the final simultaneous damage batch, with exact replay.

A canonically placed Deathtouch counter enters the immutable combat source snapshot, makes one positive damage lethal for assignment ordering, and destroys both high-toughness blockers through the final damage-result state action with exact replay.

A canonically placed Trample counter changes both the projected damage recipients and authoritative lethal-before-spill validation; an underassignment rolls back and the legal assignment replays exactly.
A canonically placed Menace counter feeds the shared projected and accepted block-declaration constraint; a one-blocker declaration rolls back and the two-blocker declaration replays exactly.

A canonically placed Hexproof counter excludes an opposing permanent while preserving its controller's target access, and a counter gained after casting makes the target illegal at CR 608.2b revalidation with seat-scoped exact replay.
The ordinary Hexproof mechanic consumes one controller-relative targeting prohibition that blocks opponents while preserving the current controller's legal targets.
A control change between cast and resolution makes the previously legal Hexproof target illegal through the same CR 608.2b target-revalidation boundary.

The ordinary Shroud mechanic consumes one controller-independent targeting prohibition, and redundant represented instances produce the same closed verdict for every acting and protected controller relation.

One authoritative four-player witness excludes and transactionally rejects the Shroud source as an opposing targeted-spell recipient, then preserves that source while its independent enchantment-cast trigger commits a canonical private draw.
A target that gains ordinary Shroud after selection becomes illegal through the same current-characteristic CR 608.2b revalidation boundary before any resolution mutation.
A generic attached layer-6 Shroud grant is consumed by ordinary target legality while attached and stops protecting the permanent immediately after the relation is detached.
Lethal marked damage and one-check Deathtouch results share the same immutable SBA snapshot and canonical destruction owner that evaluates current ordinary Indestructible.
Ordinary Trample assigns lethal damage from toughness and prior damage without reducing that threshold merely because Indestructible can prohibit later destruction.
Current ordinary Indestructible prohibits Deathtouch destruction while the temporal marker is still consumed at that same state-based-action check.
A canonically placed Indestructible counter changes the shared effective-keyword view used by destruction, and canonical removal immediately restores ordinary destroyability.
A four-player fixed-set destruction batch composes APNAP replacement choices, shield counters, and ordinary Indestructible with seat privacy and exact replay.
A Prowess trigger freezes its controller and resolves through the canonical identity-locked layer 7c effect owner, following the same physical source through control changes but not zone changes.
Prowess and an independent opponent-cast trigger consume one normalized committed spell event and enter one sealed multi-controller APNAP batch.
A creature selected for Convoke is excluded from the same spell's mana-source plan, while leaving it unselected permits its represented mana ability to pay the remaining cost.
A creature card cast for its represented Bestow cost is evaluated as an Aura spell, allowing an Aura-query fixed reduction while rejecting a creature-only reduction.
A represented fixed spell reduction applies after Kicker is added to the total cost and before the combined cost is paid.
A represented fixed spell reduction changes the generic remainder before Convoke selects and taps a creature to pay it.
A represented Devoid spell is colorless in the all-zone characteristic view consumed by a colorless-query fixed reduction.

A fixed counter-placement casting cost enters the cost-qualified counter replacement tree before mana, counters, the spell move, or the stack mutates; its affected-seat continuation survives restart and replays exactly.

One typed binary cost exposes fixed-life and fixed-mana branches as distinct total-cost options; static reduction can make the mana branch payable without allowing spell-restricted mana or charging the unselected life branch.

The selected discard branch retains its typed identity while competing destination replacements suspend before hand, mana, spell, or stack mutation; the private continuation survives restart and replays exactly.

A private fixed discard casting cost suspends for the affected seat's competing destination replacements before the hand, mana pool, spell zone, or stack mutates; its sealed continuation survives restart and replays exactly.

A fixed sacrifice casting cost suspends before mutation, survives restart, commits only the replacement-selected exile transition, and dispatches one normalized final-destination zone event rather than a false graveyard event before exact replay.

Ordinary Echo freezes its trigger controller and control-acquisition fact while retaining logical-object revalidation, so control change does not retarget the choice and a departed-and-returned source cannot satisfy the old trigger.
Simultaneous ordinary Echo occurrences enter the canonical APNAP and same-controller ordering batch before any pay-or-sacrifice choice resolves.
One source-spanned spell program revalidates its public damageable target, commits damage, then performs the later private draw in printed order with exact replay.

Kolaghan's Command announces an ordered graveyard-card and public damage target pair, suspends its first selected mode for the command-zone destination replacement without exposing the private continuation, then resumes the same resolution to revalidate and damage the second target with exact replay.
The strictest current typed maximum and simultaneous opposing power/toughness counter removal share one immutable SBA snapshot and one canonical exact-removal transaction.
Intrinsic tapped entry and controller-wide untapped entry participate in the same immutable CR 614 event and affected-controller CR 616 ordering loop.
Ordinary land play suspends before battlefield mutation, projects only the affected seat's visible order choice, resumes the exact action, and replays the two-command Game Record exactly.

The selected Age-Graced Chapel face enters tapped while a second copy's Glasswing Grace face uses the advertised creature target, resolves attached, and applies its typed characteristics without face-program leakage.

A legal simple Aura remains reciprocally attached while private APNAP discard choices suspend, Dauthi replaces the simultaneous graveyard moves with public exile, and the exact record replays to the same attachment and zone state.
Lotus Field's typed entry program makes it enter tapped while current printed Hexproof excludes an opponent's target, permits its controller's target, and leaves nontarget checks unaffected.

Ruins of Oran-Rief enters tapped through its source-pinned replacement, cannot activate its tap-cost ability in that state, then after becoming untapped targets only a current-turn colorless creature and places the counter through the typed transaction.
The face-named Fell program supplies the advertised target schema and accepted cast while Fell Mire enters tapped; resolution then revalidates a departed target and performs no destruction.
Trusted-only action authority rejects the unsupported target-predicate spell face without changing authoritative state while the exact Agadeem land face remains playable and enters tapped.

A fixed Equipment activation, a targeted Aura spell, both attached modifiers, a live Thopter anthem, a locked until-end-of-turn modifier, and a canonical draw execute together on one authoritative battlefield without losing attachment or characteristic state.

Exact attached, anthem, and until-end-of-turn characteristic owners compose on one object while every witness card retains explicit replacement-applicability and replacement-ordering residuals instead of lowering unsupported prose.

Positive damage from a Deathtouch- and Lifelink-counter source with Infect produces the exact damage results; Doubling Season correctly excludes the rule-generated Infect counters, doubles a later effect-generated placement, and keeps its unsupported token replacement explicitly residual.
The compiled sequence commits its printed draw, suspends the later counter instruction for competing quantity replacements, and resumes only the uncommitted counter instruction.
The fixed sequence and canonical draw owner preserve printed order and private draw state before the independent counter instruction suspends.

Furnace Skullbomb exposes only a controller-owned artifact or creature target, rejects an opponent-controlled creature without mutation, then places counters on the legal target and performs the independent private draw.
A fixed controller-cast counter trigger consumes exactly one committed normalized spell-cast occurrence and resolves its already typed fixed counter body.
A fixed controlled-land counter trigger consumes exactly one committed normalized land-entry occurrence and retains the entered object's immutable event facts.
Ordinary draw and exact second-draw occurrences discover their compiled fixed counter consumers through one public normalized event batch.
The canonical draw commit emits one public normalized occurrence without exposing the drawn object's hidden identity to the consuming trigger.
A compiled fixed counter trigger consumes one public normalized life-gain occurrence carrying the final replacement-adjusted amount.
Immediate and semantic-choice life transactions emit the same normalized positive result only after their canonical typed commit.
A positive committed Lifelink damage result emits one normalized life-gain occurrence in the same damage-result trigger batch.
A positive life-gain prevention aftermath emits one normalized occurrence after the canonical damage result commits.
Hallowed Healer compiles its ordinary fixed shield while the separate Threshold prevention ability remains residual, and strict runtime admission rejects the incomplete CardProgram.
Winds of Qal Sisma compiles its unconditional Fog clause while its Ferocious replacement applicability stays residual, and strict runtime admission rejects the incomplete CardProgram.
Winds of Qal Sisma keeps its conditional instead branch outside trust while preserving the independently typed Fog clause, and strict runtime admission rejects the incomplete CardProgram.
A semantic-choice life intent suspends before mutation, applies two compiled gain multipliers, and replays the replacement-resolved life total exactly once.
A fixed scheduled counter trigger suspends its two-counter body before mutation and resumes only after the affected controller orders competing quantity replacements.
Two simultaneous fixed counter triggers controlled by different players enter one ordinary four-player APNAP placement batch.
Innkeeper's Talent and Invasion of Moag retain replacement-applicability residuals while their independent fixed counter trigger emits one trusted executable CardProgram.
Innkeeper's Talent and Invasion of Moag retain self-replacement and prevention-ordering residuals while their independent fixed counter trigger emits one trusted executable CardProgram.
A controller may decline an optional fixed counter trigger without mutation or accept it and suspend before mutation while competing counter-quantity replacements are ordered and replayed exactly.

Vile Requiem compiles its optional upkeep counter body through the fixed counter effect owner while its separate variable mass-destruction and regeneration prohibition remains material, so the complete CardProgram fails closed at runtime admission.

Serra's Hymn compiles its optional upkeep counter trigger exactly while its separate variable divided damage-prevention activation remains material, so the complete CardProgram fails closed at runtime admission.

Vile Requiem compiles its optional upkeep counter trigger exactly while its separate variable mass-destruction and regeneration prohibition remains material, so the complete CardProgram fails closed at runtime admission.
